description:
Set in the sought-after suburb of Sandyford in South County Dublin, these impressive 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments offer an exceptional standard of modern living just 22 minutes by Luas from St. Stephen’s Green. Residents enjoy a prime location with a dedicated Luas stop on the doorstep, providing seamless access to the city centre as well as nearby shopping centres, cafés, restaurants and a wide range of local amenities.
 
The apartments boast bright, thoughtfully designed interiors, with floor-to-ceiling windows that flood living spaces and bedrooms with natural light throughout the day. Many homes enjoy breathtaking views across Dublin Bay and towards the Dublin Mountains, creating a striking connection to the surrounding landscape. Elegantly landscaped gardens and courtyards enhance the sense of calm and quality, while private balconies provide the perfect setting to relax and take in the scenery.
 
A dedicated on-site concierge service elevates everyday living, assisting with facility bookings, maintenance requests and the overall management of the development, while ensuring residents’ safety, privacy and peace of mind. An extensive range of private amenities has been carefully curated to support modern lifestyles, including a large, fully equipped gym, cinema room, games room, entertaining kitchen, residents’ lounge and a children’s playroom.
 
Everyday convenience is further enhanced by a selection of on-site retail and services, including convenience stores, cafés and eateries, a crèche and beauty salon, allowing residents to enjoy a vibrant, self-contained community without the need to travel far.
 
This development offers an ideal balance of comfort, convenience and choice, attracting a diverse community of professionals, families and lifestyle-focused residents who appreciate quality design and an outstanding location.
